name: app.R
content:
# Code from shiny::runExample("01_hello')

library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)

sheetname = "1fbxi0gsUxb9lJgli9LJL8PNKSwWiMvHx8UfjvMNzuuQ"
sheetname2 = "StockData"
url <-  paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",sheetname,"/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=",sheetname2)
place <-  read.csv(url)
place$Date = as.Date(place$Date)

sheetname = "1riSYdnvql9O5OkVBlVEAw1ic3_gG0iRDxePvXP0KCyw"
sheetname2 = "ocean"
url <-  paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",sheetname,"/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=",sheetname2)
ocean <<-  read.csv(url)

divs = function(w,ml,mb,mt,bg,h) { paste0("display: inline-block;vertical-align:bottom; width:",w,";margin-left:", ml,"; margin-bottom:", mb,";margin-top:", mt,
                                          ";background-color:",bg,";height:",h,";") }

# Define UI for app that draws a histogram ----
ui <- fluidPage(

  # App title ----
  titlePanel("Hello Shiny!"),

  # Sidebar layout with input and output definitions ----
  sidebarLayout(

    # Sidebar panel for inputs ----
    sidebarPanel(

      # Input: Slider for the number of bins ----
      sliderInput(
        inputId = "bins",
        label = "Number of bins:",
        min = 1,
        max = 50,
        value = 30
      )
    ),

    # Main panel for displaying outputs ----
    mainPanel(
    selectInput("stocklist1","",choices = unique(place$Symbol)),
      #Output: Histogram ----
      fluidRow(column(6,div(style=divs("46vw","10px","30px","-30px","",""),
                            plotlyOutput("blackboxintro1",height = 250))),
               column(6,div(style=divs("46vw","-15px","30px","-30px","",""),
                            plotlyOutput("blackboxintro2",height = 250)))),
      DTOutput("datatable")
    )
  )
)

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram ----
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  session$onSessionEnded(function() { stopApp() })
  # Histogram of the Old Faithful Geyser Data ----
  # with requested number of bins
  # This expression that generates a histogram is wrapped in a call
  # to renderPlot to indicate that:
  #
  # 1. It is "reactive" and therefore should be automatically
  #    re-executed when inputs (input$bins) change
  # 2. Its output type is a plot

 
  observeEvent(input$stocklist1,{
    d = place %>% filter(Symbol %in% "MSFT" & !is.na(Price))
    dmax = max(d$Date)
    output$blackboxintro1 = renderPlotly({
    data = place %>% filter(str_detect(num,"2") & Symbol %in% input$stocklist1)
    # data = place %>% filter(Company1 %in% input$stocklist1 & str_detect(num,numGrab()))
    # if (numGrab() %in% c("9","8", "7","6","5")) {
    #   data = data %>% na.omit(Price)
    #
    # } else {
    #   data$month = floor_date(data$Date,"month")
    #   d = data %>% filter(is.na(Price) == FALSE)
    #   d = d %>% slice_max(order_by = Date,n =1)
    #   data = data %>% group_by(month) %>% slice_max(order_by = Date,n = 1 )
    #   data = rbind(d,data)


    #}

    #   data = data %>% distinct(Date,.keep_all = TRUE)
    #   data = data %>% arrang
    #data = place %>% filter(Symbol %in% "AAPL"  & str_detect(num,"2"))

    #get_fig(data,ab1,"2")

    #data = place %>% filter(Symbol %in% "NVDA" )
    #bdata = s3readRDS(bucket = "boxioy.com","blackboxdata1.rds")
    #data = place %>% filter(Symbol %in% "AMZN" )
    data = as_tibble(data)
    data = data %>% arrange(Date)


    #data = data %>% group_by(w = floor_date(Date,"week")) %>% slice_max(order_by = Date, n = 1)
    #data = distinct(data,Symbol,Date,.keep_all = TRUE)
    #data$w = NULL
    vline <- function(x = 0, color = "green") {
      list(type = "line",y0 = 0,y1 = 1, yref = "paper",
           x0 = x,x1 = x,line = list(color = color, dash = "solid")) }
    fig <- plot_ly(data, x = ~Date, y = ~trend_lower, name = 'Lower', type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
                   line=list(color=c('gray'),dash = "solid"))
    fig <- fig %>% add_trace(y = ~trend_upper, name = "Upper", mode = 'lines', fill = "tonexty",
                             fillcolor='rgba(216, 247, 255, 0.5)',line=list(color=c('black'),dash = "solid"))
    fig <- fig %>% add_trace(y = ~yhat, name = 'Trend', mode = 'lines', fill = "tonexty",
                             fillcolor='rgba(216, 247, 255, 0.5)',line=list(color=c('#004568'),dash = "solid"))
    fig <- fig %>% add_trace(y = ~Price, name = 'Price', mode = 'lines',line=list(color=c('green'),dash = "solid"))
    a = max(na.omit(data$Price))
    b = max(na.omit(data$trend_upper))
    c = max(na.omit(data$yhat))
    amax = max(a,b,c) *1.1
    a = min(na.omit(data$Price))
    b = min(na.omit(data$trend_upper))
    c = min(na.omit(data$yhat))
    amin = min(a,b,c) *.90
    brange = as.numeric(max(data$Date) - min(data$Date))
    brange = brange/14
    a = data %>% na.omit()
    a = max(a$Date)
    fig = fig %>% layout(annotations = list(text = paste0(format(a,"<b>%b %d, %Y"),"—"),  x = Sys.Date()-brange, y = amax * .95 ,showarrow=FALSE ),
                         shapes = list(list(type = "rect", text = 'decline1', fillcolor = "white", line = list(color = "green"),
                                            opacity = 0.1, y0 = 0.6, y1 = amax, x0 = dmax, x1 = max(data$Date)),
                                       vline(dmax,text)))

    Noax <- list(title = "", zeroline = FALSE,
                 showline = FALSE, showticklabels = TRUE,
                 side = "right", showgrid = TRUE, fixedrange = F,
                 range = c(amin,amax),
                 ticks = F,
                 rangemode = 'tozero', zerolinewidth = 5,
                 rangemode = 'tozero', showgrid = FALSE, showline = T, ticks = 'inside' )

    fig = fig %>%
      layout(hovermode = "x unified") %>%
      layout(
        showlegend = F,
        list(showgrid = TRUE),
        legend = list(orientation = 'h'),
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = '', font = list(size = 12)),
                     fixedrange = F, showgrid = TRUE, ticks = 'outside',
                     type = 'date', hoverformat = "<b>%b %d, %Y"),
        yaxis = Noax
      ) %>% config(displayModeBar = F)
    fig <- fig %>% layout(xaxis = list(tickformat = "%m-%d-%y"))
    fig

  })
  })
  output$datatable = renderDT({datatable(ocean)})
}

# Create Shiny app ----
shinyApp(ui, server, options = list(launch.browser = TRUE,port = 2030))
